summary: Master IP licensing, valuation, and contract drafting. Learn to negotiate royalties and mitigate risks in this 5-day expert-led training for professionals.
lede: Intellectual property contracting and licensing covers structuring agreements to commercialize and protect intangible assets. For IP counsel, technology transfer officers, and contract or licensing managers, it addresses the practical work of assessing IP portfolios and negotiating clear licensing terms. The syllabus develops capabilities in IP asset audits and valuation, drafting grants of rights and royalty provisions, and managing risks involving software, data, and AI-generated content.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for professionals who manage, protect, or commercialize intangible assets in complex industrial and technological environments.
modules: IP Asset Strategy and Lifecycle Management
Liability and Risk Mitigation in IP
prerequisites: Participants should have at least three years of experience in legal, R&D, procurement, or commercial management roles. A foundational understanding of patents, trademarks, and copyrights is required. It is recommended that attendees bring a redacted example of a licensing challenge they currently face for use in workshop exercises.
